title: Water cooler not working
description: The water cooler on the second floor has not worked for three days. Many students are affected.

title: Leaking tap in washroom
description: A tap in the washroom keeps dripping and wastes water. It has been like this for a week.

title: Broken bench in canteen
description: One bench has a loose leg. It is not urgent but should be repaired sometime.

title: Ceiling fans not working
description: All the fans in room 105 are off and the room is very hot during afternoon lectures.

title: Cracked window in library
description: A window pane is cracked and rain water comes inside when it rains.

title: Peeling paint in corridor
description: Paint is peeling off the walls. It is only a cosmetic issue and can be done sometime this year.

title: Lift gets stuck frequently
description: The lift stops between floors several times a week. Students with injuries and staff cannot use the stairs.

title: Potholes on campus road
description: Deep potholes near the gate make bikes slip, especially after rain.

title: No drinking water on the floor
description: There has been no drinking water available on the third floor since Tuesday and students have to go down to the ground floor.

title: Overflowing dustbins
description: Dustbins have not been emptied for days. There is a bad smell and flies everywhere.

title: Not enough seating in lecture hall
description: The hall has fewer benches than students, so many students sit on the floor during lectures.

title: Broken washroom door lock
description: The lock on the last cubicle door is broken so the door cannot be closed.

title: Wi-Fi not connecting in library
description: The Wi-Fi has been slow and keeps disconnecting since Monday. Students cannot access online study material.

title: Portal not showing exam results
description: The student portal shows an error when I open my semester results. It has been like this for two days.

title: Projector not turning on
description: The projector does not turn on. Teachers are using the whiteboard instead.

title: Computer lab systems not booting
description: More than half of the computers fail to boot, so practicals cannot be done and our exams are next week.

title: Cannot log in to college email
description: I cannot log in to my college email since the password reset and I am missing important notices.

title: Recorded lectures not loading
description: Recorded lecture videos keep buffering for everyone in my batch.

title: Library printer out of order
description: The printer in the library has been out of order for two weeks.

title: Online exam portal crashed
description: The exam portal crashed during the internal test and many students lost their answers.

title: Slow Wi-Fi in hostel rooms
description: The Wi-Fi in the hostel rooms is very slow at night so we cannot study online.

title: Street light broken near hostel gate
description: The street light has not worked for a week. It is completely dark at night and girls are scared to walk back.

title: Sparking wire in computer lab
description: An exposed wire near the third row sparked today when a student touched the table. Please fix it before someone gets hurt.

title: Stray dogs near hostel entrance
description: A group of stray dogs chases students every evening and a few students have almost been bitten.

title: Expired fire extinguishers
description: The fire extinguishers show an expiry date from last year and the lab uses open flames.

title: Slippery floor at main entrance
description: The floor becomes very slippery when wet and two students fell this week.

title: Strangers entering through back gate
description: Unknown people walk in through the back gate without any checking, even at night.

title: CCTV cameras not working in parking
description: The CCTV cameras in the parking area have been off for a month after two bike thefts.

title: Loose staircase railing
description: The railing on the second staircase is loose and someone could fall.

title: Gas smell near hostel kitchen
description: There is a smell of gas near the hostel kitchen every evening and the staff say there may be a leak.

title: Scholarship verification delayed
description: I submitted my scholarship documents three weeks ago and verification is still pending.

title: Fee receipt not issued
description: I paid my semester fee ten days ago but I have not received the receipt yet.

title: Bonafide certificate delayed
description: I applied for a bonafide certificate fifteen days ago and it is still not ready. I need it for my passport.

title: Wrong name on ID card
description: My ID card has a spelling mistake in my name and the library does not accept it.

title: Hostel room allotment pending
description: I have been waiting a month for a hostel room and I travel three hours every day.

title: Caution money refund not processed
description: My caution money refund has been pending for six months despite many visits to the office.

title: Transfer certificate needed urgently
description: I need my transfer certificate within five days for another college admission deadline but the office says it will take three weeks.

title: Rude behaviour of office staff
description: The staff at the counter speak rudely and refuse to explain the process.

title: Attendance recorded wrongly
description: My attendance shows absent on days I was present and I may be barred from the exam in two weeks.

title: Syllabus not completed
description: The teacher has covered only half of the syllabus and the exam is in a month.

title: Timetable clash
description: Two of my core subjects are scheduled at the same time on Tuesdays.

title: Lab equipment is outdated
description: Many oscilloscopes give wrong readings so our experiments often fail.

title: Not enough textbook copies
description: The recommended textbooks have only two copies for around 200 students.

title: Wrong marks in internal result
description: My internal exam marks are shown as 12 in the results but I scored 21.

title: Request for doubt-clearing classes
description: Students would like extra doubt-clearing classes before the semester exam.

title: Teacher often absent
description: Our chemistry teacher has missed most classes this month and no substitute has been arranged.

title: Suggestion for more sports facilities
description: We would like a basketball court and more sports equipment for students.

title: Construction noise during exams
description: There is drilling noise from the construction next door during exams and it is hard to concentrate.

title: Lost wallet in canteen
description: I lost my wallet in the canteen yesterday and it has my ID card in it.

title: Request to start a photography club
description: A few of us would like to start a photography club and need a room and permission.
